verdict.rationale: Gitea provides first-party pieces for headless automation: an official CLI (tea), an official go-sdk, an API and webhooks, its own Actions CI with an official runner, and a container image with file-based app.ini configuration for unattended deployment. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing tea or the API used non-interactively in CI pipelines (token auth, machine-readable output), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI-driven automation.
